text: candanasuttaṃ [260] ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho candano devaputto bhagavantaṃ gāthāyaฝ ajjhabhāsi kathaṃsu 3 tarati oghaṃ rattindivamatandito appatiṭṭhe anālambe ko gambhīre na sīdatīti . [261] sabbadā sīlasampanno paññavā susamāhito āraddhaviriyo pahitatto oghaṃ tarati duttaraṃ #1 yu. kathaṃvidhaṃ . 2 sī. jhānapati . 3 sī. kosūdha . virato kāmasaññāya rūpasaññojanātito 1 nandibhavaparikkhīṇo 2 so gambhīre na sīdatīti . chaṭṭhaṃ
